rationaleNote: Gap-filling fixture for the HTML port's sweep test: a misconception card with a diagram visual (triangle-square part-whole model, not a photo), exercising the diagram-under-the-pair branch. The docx builder's diagram maths for this branch renders the picture at 0.75x its stated inches (render-card.js:452-455 works in a 72-per-inch unit without the x96 pixel correction panelWithVisual applies elsewhere); the HTML port matches that size deliberately, so both builders should print the diagram at the same size.

items.label: Don't
items.text: Write the biggest number in a triangle because it looks like it needs the most room.

items.label: Do
items.text: The whole always goes in the square. The two parts go in the triangles.
